subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary for Your Trip to Paris
body: Dear [Recipient], We are excited to share the details of your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight is scheduled for 10:00 AM on July 15th, and your hotel reservation has been confirmed at the Eiffel Tower View Hotel. We have also arranged for a guided tour of the Louvre Museum on the second day of your stay. Please review the attached itinerary for more information. We hope you have a wonderful time in the City of Light! Best regards, Travel Agency Team
